args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight info, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with wide brim
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Waterproof watch

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Quick-dry hiking pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve lightweight shirt (for sun protection)
- Small backpack for day trips
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Toiletries
- Hairbrush/comb
- Lip balm with SPF

Electronics:
- Universal power adapter
- Portable power bank
- Headphones
- Laptop/tablet (if needed)

Miscellaneous:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella or rain jacket

Special Activities:
- Semi-formal outfit for the Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center (June 16)
- Spa attire for relaxation day (June 17)
- Shopping list for Ala Moana Center (June 19)
